verses.text: For the one directing. With stringed instruments according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O YHWH, in Your anger do not rebuke me, and do not discipline me in Your rage.

segments.text: For the one directing. With stringed instruments according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O YHWH, in Your anger do not rebuke me, and do not discipline me in Your rage.

verses.text: Be gracious to me, O YHWH, for I [am] weak; heal me, O YHWH, for my bones are disturbed.

segments.text: Be gracious to me, O YHWH, for I [am] weak; heal me, O YHWH, for my bones are disturbed.

verses.text: And my soul is disturbed greatly; and You, O YHWH, until when?

segments.text: And my soul is disturbed greatly; and You, O YHWH, until when?

verses.text: Return, O YHWH, draw out my soul; save me for the sake of Your loving devotion.

segments.text: Return, O YHWH, draw out my soul; save me for the sake of Your loving devotion.

verses.text: For in death [is] no remembrance of You; in Sheol, who can give thanks to You?

segments.text: For in death [is] no remembrance of You; in Sheol, who can give thanks to You?

verses.text: I have grown weary in my sighing; I cause my bed to swim through all the night; with my tears I melt my couch.

segments.text: I have grown weary in my sighing; I cause my bed to swim through all the night; with my tears I melt my couch.

verses.text: My eye has wasted away from grief; it grows old because of all afflicting me.

segments.text: My eye has wasted away from grief; it grows old because of all afflicting me.

verses.text: Turn away from me, all workers of iniquity, for YHWH has heard the voice of my weeping.

segments.text: Turn away from me, all workers of iniquity, for YHWH has heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.text: YHWH has heard my supplication; YHWH has received my prayer.

segments.text: YHWH has heard my supplication; YHWH has received my prayer.

verses.text: Let all my enemies be ashamed and disturbed greatly; let them turn back [and] be ashamed in an instant.

segments.text: Let all my enemies be ashamed and disturbed greatly; let them turn back [and] be ashamed in an instant.
